name: alakazam_ml_v27
model: The inherited LightGBM action ranker and bounded target ranker are unchanged. v27 changes deterministic route, target-role, and optional-draw gates only.
model_scope: Hard rules own legality, terminal wins, attack and KO routes, prize tiers, Boss use, support-pivot conversion, strategic evolution-line value, target-specific hand budget, board-count floor, matchup pressure, and Dudunsparce safety. The inherited target model remains bounded to +/-800 inside deterministic target value.

source_evidence.interpretation: The requested fixes concern deterministic sequencing and decision thresholds, not the 60-card list. Top-team evidence supports support-Pokemon Energy attachments, attack-connected Boss use, early pressure, and deliberate Dudunsparce/endgame management.

v27_rule_changes: Score Active support Pokemon -> attach one Energy if needed -> retreat -> ready benched Alakazam -> attack as one deterministic route. Enriching Energy contributes its net +3 hand change before Powerful Hand damage is computed.
Evaluate the support-pivot route before Fezandipiti-specific and Enriching-specific early returns, fixing the v26 branch-order omission.
Carry strategic value backward through the card database evolution graph so a main attacker, its Stage 1, and its Basic are prioritized over disposable same-prize bodies.
Restrict generic lineage value to ex, Mega, Stage 2, high-output Stage 1, or strategic Ability endpoints; incidental low-output evolution lines receive no main-strategy bonus.
Preserve terminal wins and higher-prize endgame KOs above evolution-line disruption.
When the chosen deterministic KO already has ceil(target HP / 20) attack-time cards and excludes the optional draw, hold Run Away Draw and Enriching draw instead of creating overkill.

ablation_flags.ALAKAZAM_V27_SUPPORT_PIVOT: 1 by default; set 0 to disable only the new support-pivot route
ablation_flags.ALAKAZAM_V27_LINE_PRIORITY: 1 by default; set 0 to disable only generic strategic-line value
ablation_flags.ALAKAZAM_V27_DRAW_BUDGET: 1 by default; set 0 to restore inherited optional-draw behavior

preserved_v26_invariants: v26 deck and both model artifacts
terminal Boss and Active win gates and prize dominance
board-count floor and Dudunsparce body-floor protection
post-resolution Dudunsparce deck accounting and low-deck exceptions
Archaludon, Grimmsnarl/Froslass, Mist Energy, Fezandipiti exposure, alternate-attacker, and protection-lock logic
known_limitations: The 287/600 mirror result is below 50% but not statistically distinguishable from an even matchup; it does not establish that v27 is stronger than v26.
Teacher-forced comparison identifies changed observed decisions but cannot simulate each counterfactual continuation.
The local generic opponents are much weaker than leaderboard opponents, and the native battle API does not expose fully deterministic RNG.

The exact hand budget intentionally values current-turn KO efficiency and keeping Dudunsparce available after a hand reset; it may forgo benign surplus setup in states not represented by the current tests.
Leaderboard promotion requires a real submission and per-matchup review; local rating or a single aggregate win rate is not sufficient.
